title: Experience design
outcomes: an experience review naming task success, accessibility, error states, consistency, and evidence
inputs: the screen, flow, prototype, or component under review
the design system and accessibility target the project declares
research and usage evidence declared as sources
minimumEvidence: every usability claim names the heuristic or the research it rests on; every accessibility finding names the WCAG success criterion
escalation: a finding that would exclude people by disability is reported as serious or fatal, never minor
a claim about how people actually behave that no research supports is labeled an assumption and handed to research
